20 Which statement about elastic and plastic deformation must be correct?
A
Elastic deformation and plastic deformation are proportional to the applied force.
B
Elastic deformation and plastic deformation cause no change in volume.
C
Elastic deformation causes heating of the material but plastic deformation does not.
D
Elastic deformation is reversible but plastic deformation is not.

hints: Focus on the word must - a statement is correct only if it is always true for elastic and plastic deformation, not just sometimes true.
Recall what happens when the applied force is removed: elastic means the atoms return to equilibrium positions, plastic means layers have slipped to new permanent positions.

Test proportionality, volume change and heating against the force-extension graph: proportionality stops at the limit of proportionality and the area under the curve beyond the elastic limit is dissipated work.
walkthrough: Identify the defining test: remove the deforming force and see if the material returns to its original length.
State the rule: elastic deformation is reversible because interatomic bonds are stretched but not broken, so stored elastic potential energy is recovered.
State the contrast: plastic deformation is irreversible because atoms or dislocations move to new positions, leaving a permanent extension after unloading.
Check the other statements: proportionality fails beyond the limit of proportionality, volume can change when a wire is stretched, and plastic work increases internal energy and heating.
The only statement that must always hold is that elastic deformation reverses and plastic deformation does not. This is option D

A.explanation: Proportionality of extension to force holds only up to the limit of proportionality, so it is not true for all elastic and plastic deformation.

B.explanation: Stretching changes length and cross-sectional area, so volume need not stay constant during elastic or plastic deformation.

C.explanation: Plastic deformation does work against internal forces and dissipates energy as heat, so the heating claim is reversed.

D.explanation: By definition elastic deformation disappears when the load is removed, while plastic deformation leaves a permanent extension.
